Class FreezeManager

java.lang.Object
com.tetris.gameLogic.FreezeManager
public class FreezeManager extends Object
Manages the state and duration of the "Time Freeze" power-up.

This class handles the activation logic, ensures the ability can only be used once per game (or per reset cycle), and sets up a timer to automatically expire the freeze effect after a configured duration.

Author:
Jacob Villegas

  • Method Details

    • tryActivate

      public boolean tryActivate(Runnable onFreezeEnd)
      Attempts to activate the freeze ability.

      Activation will fail if the board is already frozen or if the ability has already been used since the last reset. If successful, it starts a JavaFX Timeline that will automatically clear the frozen state after GameConfig.FREEZE_DURATION.

      Parameters:
      onFreezeEnd - A Runnable to execute when the timer expires (e.g., resuming the game loop or playing a sound).
      Returns:
      true if the freeze was successfully activated; false if it was blocked (already used or active).

    • reset

      public void reset()
      Resets the manager state, allowing the ability to be used again.

      This is typically called when a new game starts.

    • isFrozen

      Returns:
